subject: Commitment rollover: billing custodian, PO evidence, and PO tracking
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@greenwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commitment rollover: billing custodian, PO evidence, and PO tracking

Hi Alex — great to hear Greenwave is moving forward with the 20% capacity top-up during the renewal window. A couple quick items to get the invoicing path lined up so finance can process the first invoice on Nov 1: 

1) We need a single billing custodian and a PO number for the uplift (so we can map invoices to your AP system). If procurement prefers a consolidated PO for the whole renewal + top-up, that works — just share the PDF.
2) Your procurement team mentioned Net45 for renewals. Can you confirm whether the top-up follows the same Net45 terms, or if you need Net30 for the initial invoice?
3) Please send your W-9 / EIN confirmation for the paying entity, or if you require our W-9 I attached a copy.

Attached: Redwood_W9_2026.pdf (redacted EIN)

Next steps: if procurement can email back the finalized PO and confirm the billing contact, I will loop finance to set up the EFT collector and push the billing schedule into our billing system.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0134
[Attachment: Redwood_W9_2026.pdf (pdf, 48KB)]

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@greenwave.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greenwave.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commitment rollover: billing custodian, PO evidence, and PO tracking

Tessa — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers from procurement: 

- We will issue a single consolidated PO that covers the 12-month renewal plus the capacity top-up. Expect the PO PDF by end of day Friday.
- Standard Net45 applies to renewals; procurement prefers Net45 for the whole amount. They asked whether Redwood can accept Net45 for the top-up as well — that should be fine.
- Attached is a placeholder authorisation email from our AP team. Our finance team will email the official PO from procurement@greenwave.com.

Can you confirm you received your W-9? Also, procurement asked for the Redwood bank remittance name (format for EFT). If you can send the exact payee name and remittance address, I will pass it to AP.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Senior Procurement Manager
Greenwave Systems
[Attachment: GW_AP_authorization.txt (txt, 2KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@greenwave.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Commitment rollover: billing custodian, PO evidence, and PO tracking

Alex — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming: we received Tessa's W-9 and I shared the remittance block below for AP: 

Payee name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Remit to: Redwood Inference, Inc. c/o Accounts Receivable
Bank: (bank details provided over secure portal)
Reference on invoice: PO GW-2026-10-14 (please include PO number on the invoice PDF)

Monica (billing ops) — once the PO lands, can you create the EFT collector and set payment terms to Net45 on the first invoice? Also flag the account for capacity-topup billing cadence so token-based usage is separated for reporting.

Alex — as a final ask, can you have procurement attach the official PO PDF to the HubSpot deal record (link below) or forward it to billing@redwood.com? That speeds internal posting.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Manager, Revenue Operations

Date: Mon, 25 Oct 2026 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Commitment rollover: billing custodian, PO evidence, and PO tracking

Alex — thanks, we just received procurement's signed PO via procurement@greenwave.com. Attached is the posted PO in our billing system and the DocuSign envelope ID. A couple items noted while onboarding: 

- PO number in your PDF: GW-PO-2026-0014 (we mapped this to internal ref GW-2026-10-14). Please verify that is the number you expect on invoices.
- Net45 has been set on the account for the renewal and the top-up as requested.
- I created EFT collector "GW-EFT-Collector-2026" and sent a DocuSign request to your AP contact to confirm bank remittance. Once signed we will transmit our bank details via the secure portal.
- We attached Redwood_W9_2026.pdf to the invoice profile per your request.

Attachments requested/added to the deal:
- Greenwave_PO_2026-10-14.pdf (official PO)
- DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/GW-PO-14 (status: sent)

If procurement can confirm the PO number and sign the DocuSign by Wednesday, we will queue the initial invoice for Nov 1 and tag it as "capacity_topup" for reporting. If anything needs to be split across legal entities, let us know now — otherwise we will proceed with single-entity billing.

Best,
Monica Patel
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Greenwave_PO_2026-10-14.pdf (pdf, 325KB)]
